ops.d: List the Gemini and embedding models served by the local-model seam.
s:
from google import genai
from google.genai import types

client = genai.Client(api_key="test",
    http_options=types.HttpOptions(base_url="{EP}"))   # Gemini Developer API alias of the Vertex seam
for m in client.models.list():
    print(m.name)

from google import genai

    http_options=types.HttpOptions(base_url="{EP}"))   # Gemini Developer API alias of the Vertex seam
